* FAQ
** How we receive messages from user
When the user sends a message to our number, Meta servers sends a post request to an endpoint given by us.
It's type is given in /src/types/whatsapp.types.ts (WaMessageBody)
** What happens when we send a survey to customer
When we send a survey to customer, we creates a record in WaSession with users phone number & surveyID.
We also saves current currentQuestionId. When the user responds to a question, we updates the calculates the next QuestionId to send (after evaluating logic jumps) & sends it to user. The response to the question is pushed to an array which will hold the responses temporarily until the survey is finished.

When the user responds to the last question, we creates a SurveyResponse record & saves all the responses till now. Then the WaSession is deleted.
